com.mixapplications.ultimateusb.title: Ultimate USB
com.mixapplications.ultimateusb.summary: Create bootable USBs, format drives, and manage retro PS2/PS3 games on Android!
com.mixapplications.ultimateusb.description:
🔌 Ultimate USB – USB Manager & Bootable Creator
Turn your phone into a PC repair shop: bootable USB drives, formatting, partitioning, drive tests and retro game tools — over a simple OTG cable.

Nearly everything works WITHOUT root (only the internal SD slot needs it), on real native FAT16/FAT32/exFAT/NTFS/EXT2/3/4 drivers.

🛠️ BOOTABLE USB & IMAGE WRITING
• Ventoy (Unofficial): multi-boot USB — many ISOs on one drive, pick at boot. Install, update or clean it, with Secure Boot support, 4K alignment, MBR/GPT and FAT32/exFAT/NTFS. Copy ISOs over, or download them straight to the drive.
• ISO Burner (ISO2USB / DROFUS): Windows 7–11, Linux, Apple DMG, Raspberry Pi, MS-DOS, FreeDOS.
 ‣ Windows customization: bypass TPM 2.0 / Secure Boot / 4GB RAM, skip the Microsoft account, create a local account, turn off BitLocker, data collection and forced Copilot/OneDrive/Outlook, copy your regional settings, "Windows CA 2023" bootloaders.
 ‣ Windows To Go: a full portable Windows that boots and runs from the drive itself.
 ‣ Linux persistence: keep your files and changes between boots.
 ‣ High-speed mode, install.wim splitting for FAT32 / Secure-Boot PCs, MBR/GPT, cluster size, label.
• Raw Write (DD): write any image byte by byte, exactly as-is.

🧹 ADVANCED DISK MANAGEMENT
• Format USB: FAT16, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS, EXT2/3/4, with MBR/GPT, cluster size and label.
• Partition Wizard: create, delete, format, rename, wipe, back up and restore partitions, convert MBR ↔ GPT, with undo before you apply.
• Bad Blocks Check: write-and-verify scan that finds failing sectors and fake-capacity drives.
• USB Defragmenter: consolidate fragmented files on FAT32 and exFAT for faster reads.
• Wipe USB: permanently erase all data and partitions.
• Backup & Restore: full byte-by-byte image of the device.

🎮 RETRO GAMING TOOLS
• PS2 USB Utils: add, remove, rename, organize and export games. Direct copy or UL split, 4GB+ ISOs, OPL playlists, ul.cfg regeneration, split-game import, quick defrag, artwork downloads, plus PS1 (.VCD) import for POPStarter.
• PS3 ISO Tools: make ISOs from folders, extract, patch target CFW version, split for FAT32, join segments, auto-rename, [online]/[auto] tags, game info, SFO & icon extraction.
• Game Converter: ISO ↔ ZSO / CSO / CHD / VCD, BIN/CUE ➔ ISO or CHD, ZSO ↔ CSO, at max compression.

📁 FILES & STORAGE
• USB File Manager: copy, move, delete, rename, search and sort — and open drive files straight in other apps, with no copy to the phone.
• Partition Mounter: mount partitions, even hidden ones, into the Android Files app, read-only or read/write.
• Partition Image Manager: create, open and browse .img/.bk images.
• Archive Extractor: 7z, RAR, ZIP, ISO, TAR, GZip, BZip2, WIM, CAB, DEB, RPM and more, with passwords.

📊 DIAGNOSTICS & HARDWARE
• Device Info & Benchmark: vendor, product, serial, block size, plus sequential and random speed tests.
• Works with flash drives, portable SSDs, card readers and OTG hubs. HDDs are not officially supported (power limits).

💰 FAIR TOKEN SYSTEM
Almost everything is FREE. Only Ventoy install/update, ISO burning, formatting and the Partition Wizard cost tokens (1–3), earned FREE by watching one short ad.

👑 PRO VERSION
One-time lifetime purchase: no ads, no tokens, archive extraction straight to USB, full offline use.

⚠️ GOOD TO KNOW
• Keep the app in the foreground — operations pause when minimized to protect the drive.
• The free version needs internet for ads; disable ad-blockers and blocking Private DNS.
• Tokens live on your device: clearing app data or uninstalling clears them. Pro is tied to your account and stays safe.
• Drive not detected? Test it on a PC, try another cable, or reformat to FAT32.

com.mixapplications.rufus.title: DROFUS - ISO 2 USB
com.mixapplications.rufus.summary: DROFUS - ISO 2 USB: Bootable Windows & Linux from Android. No PC, No Root!
com.mixapplications.rufus.description:
🔥 DROFUS — ISO Burner for Android
(Also known as ISO 2 USB or ISO to USB)

Burn full operating system images directly to USB — no PC required.
DROFUS is a standalone ISO burning utility built for Android. Whether you're preparing a bootable Windows installer, a live Linux drive with persistence, or flashing a Raspberry
Pi image, DROFUS gives you full control over partition schemes, file systems and image handling. Built for speed, precision and manual configuration.

🧨 SUPPORTED IMAGES
• Burn ISO, DMG and IMG files directly to USB
• Compressed images too — .gz, .xz and .zip are unpacked as they are written
• Compatible with:
– Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10, 11
– FreeDOS / MS-DOS
– Non-bootable drives (plain formatting)
– Modern GNU/Linux distros released after 2010 (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch…)
– macOS DMG (Intel-based only)
– Raspberry Pi OS and other ARM-based images

🪟 WINDOWS
• Choose the partition scheme and file system yourself
– GPT (UEFI) or MBR (BIOS / UEFI-CSM)
– NTFS or FAT32
• Pick the exact Windows edition from inside the ISO
• Windows To Go — a real, portable Windows that boots and runs from the USB drive itself
• Works with official Microsoft ISOs, unmodified
• Split install.wim so a large image fits on FAT32
• High-speed mode for faster writes

⚙️ WINDOWS SETUP CUSTOMIZATION (Win 10/11)
• Bypass the Windows 11 requirements — TPM 2.0, Secure Boot and 4GB+ RAM
• Remove the online Microsoft account requirement
• Create a local account with your own user name
• Skip the privacy questions and disable data collection
• Disable BitLocker automatic device encryption
• QoL tweaks — don't force Copilot, OneDrive, Outlook, Fast Startup and more
• Match the installer's regional options to this device
• Set the target PC's internal drives offline
• Apply SkuSiPolicy.p7b on installation (see KB5042562)
• Optional "Windows UEFI CA 2023" signed bootloaders

🐧 LINUX, DMG & RASPBERRY PI
• Written raw, block for block, preserving the original layout and boot structure
• Or open Advanced Options for a Linux ISO to choose the file system and partition scheme instead
• Add a persistent partition to a live Linux drive — keep your files, apps and settings between boots

🖴 FORMATTING
• Non-bootable mode formats the drive on its own terms: GPT or MBR, FAT32 / exFAT / NTFS, custom cluster size and volume label

🛡 CHECKS BEFORE YOU BURN
• Warns when an ISO looks truncated or corrupted from an interrupted download
• Warns when the selected file isn't actually bootable
• Checks free space on both the drive and phone storage before starting

🔌 COMPATIBILITY
• USB flash drives, SD card adapters and external SSDs
• OTG support required — a built-in guide shows how to enable it
• Root access only needed for the internal SD slot
• Android 7.0+ · available in 45+ languages

💰 TOKENS
Tokens are only charged when a burn does real work beyond a raw copy.
• Windows installation or Windows To Go → 2 tokens
• Linux burn using Advanced Options (custom file system or persistence) → 2 tokens
• FreeDOS / MS-DOS → 1 token
• Non-bootable / format only → 1 token
Free: raw writes of Linux, Raspberry Pi and DMG images — plus every manual configuration tool.
Earn tokens by watching a short rewarded ad, or buy them directly.

📢 ADS & PRO
DROFUS shows banner and rewarded video ads to keep the core features free.
Upgrade to Pro (one-time, lifetime) to remove all ads, disable the token system entirely, and use the app offline or with an ad blocker enabled.

⚠️ NOTES
• Internet required and ad blockers / blocking Private DNS off — unless you own Pro
• Keep the app in the foreground during USB operations

Download DROFUS now and burn smarter — right from your Android device.

com.mixapplications.usbtools.title: USB TOOLS
com.mixapplications.usbtools.summary: Multi Tool For USB Devices / Console Games
com.mixapplications.usbtools.description:
🧰 USB Tools — Format, Repair, Test & Back Up USB Drives
Format, partition, defragment, benchmark and test USB drives — no PC required.
USB Tools is a complete USB maintenance suite for Android. Format drives, manage partitions, detect fake capacity and bad blocks, defragment, benchmark and back up your data —
all from your phone. Most features work without root. Internal SD card slot access requires root.

💽 Disk Management
USB Formatter
• Format to FAT16, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS, EXT2/3/4
• Choose file system, cluster size and volume label
• Choose MBR (Legacy) or GPT (UEFI) partition table
Partition Wizard
• Create, delete, format and rename partitions
• Convert partition table between MBR and GPT
• Back up and restore individual partitions
• Queue several changes and undo before applying
USB Defragmenter
• Defragment FAT32 and exFAT partitions
• Improves speed and fixes fragmented files (required by PS2/OPL)
USB Wipe
• Securely erase all data and partitions from USB or SD card
Backup & Restore
• Create full backups of USB content
• Restore from saved backups

🔍 Diagnostics & Info
Bad Blocks Check
• Scan for bad blocks using 1 or 2 write/read test passes
• Detect fake USB drives and fake SD cards (counterfeit capacity)
• Full report: read, write and corruption errors + bad block locations
USB Device Benchmark
• Sequential and random read/write speed tests
• Read-only or read/write modes
Device Info & USB Descriptors
• Vendor ID, Product ID, manufacturer, serial, version, interfaces
• Capacity, block size, total blocks, partition count

🎮 Gaming Tools
PS2 USB Utils — OPL Games Utility
• Import, organize, rename, delete, defragment and export PS2 games
• Supports >4GB ISOs, BIN/ISO formats, USBExtreme (.ul) conversion
• Import games already in .ul format
• Auto-generate ul.cfg and OPL playlists
• Download game arts (covers) automatically
• PlayStation 1 support: import .VCD games for POPStarter
• Convert to MBR without data loss
• Clear corrupted or unused game files
PS3 ISO Tools — ISO Workflow Manager
• Create (Make) ISO from folders or Extract ISO back to folders
• Patch ISOs for specific Target CFW versions
• Split large ISOs for FAT32 compatibility or Join file segments
• View ISO info (title, game ID)
• Modify: Auto-rename (Name/ID), add [auto]/[online] tags, extract icon/SFO
Game Converter
• Convert between ISO, BIN/CUE, VCD, ZSO, CSO and CHD
• Compress ISO to ZSO/CSO to save space

🔌 Supported Devices
• USB flash drives, SD adapters, SSDs, hubs (OTG — no root)
• Internal SD card slot (requires root)

💰 Token Usage
Tokens are used only for advanced formatting and partitioning actions. You can earn tokens by watching rewarded ads or buy them directly.
Token-required actions:
• USB Formatter:
– FAT16, FAT32, EXFAT, NTFS, EXT2–4 → 1 token
• Partition Wizard:
– Single partition → same as above
– Multi-partition → up to 3 tokens
• PS2 USB fix (if formatting needed) → 1 token
Free actions:
• USB Wipe, Backup & Restore
• Bad Blocks Check & fake drive detection
• USB Defragmenter, Benchmark, Device Info
• Game Converter
• PS2 & PS3 tools (except formatting)
• File system selection and partition setup

📢 Ad-Supported Experience
Banner ads and rewarded video ads keep core features free.
Upgrade to Pro to:
• Remove all ads
• Unlock unlimited access
• Disable the tokens system
• Use offline and with ad blockers

🌍 Available in 40+ languages

⚠️ Notes
• Internet required unless using Pro
• Disable ad blockers unless using Pro
• Keep the app in the foreground during USB operations
• If USB isn’t recognized:
– The USB is likely working correctly
– Test it on a PC to confirm
– Use FAT32 for better compatibility

Download USB Tools now and keep your storage clean, tested, backed up, and ready to go.

com.mixapplications.miuithemeeditor.title: ChaoMe Theme Editor
com.mixapplications.miuithemeeditor.summary: Build & install custom MIUI and HyperOS themes: icons, wallpapers & fonts.
com.mixapplications.miuithemeeditor.description:
Make your Xiaomi phone truly yours. ChaoMe Theme Editor is a complete studio for creating, customizing, and installing themes on MIUI and HyperOS — no PC, no root required.

Start from a theme you already have installed, or build one piece by piece. Change exactly what you want, preview it, and export a ready-to-install .mtz theme in a couple of taps.


WHAT YOU CAN CUSTOMIZE

• App icons — pick from installed icon packs, mask and reshape system icons, or drop in your own images
• Wallpapers & lock screen — set your own home and lock backgrounds
• Status bar — swap the toggle/quick-settings icons and status-bar art for a fresh look
• Notification panel — restyle the panel background and shortcut icons
• Fonts — apply a custom system font
• Boot animation — change what shows when your phone starts
• Contacts, dialer & call screen — colors, backgrounds and buttons
• Theme details — set the title, author, designer and description that appear in the Themes app


HOW IT WORKS

1. Open an installed theme to edit it, or start a new one from scratch.
2. Tap through the sections and change whatever you like — every screen has a live preview.
3. Export. ChaoMe packs everything into a standard .mtz theme file.
4. Install it into the stock Themes app and apply.

On Android 11 and newer, Google's storage rules stop any app from writing directly into the Themes app's private folder. ChaoMe uses Shizuku to bridge that gap so your theme installs cleanly — it will guide you through the one-time Shizuku setup, and it never needs root.


BUILT FOR MODERN XIAOMI

ChaoMe understands the theme-engine versions MIUI and HyperOS use, and writes the compatibility fields (uiVersion, miuiAdapterVersion, miuixAdapterVersion) so your components actually apply instead of being silently skipped — including on the latest HyperOS releases.


WHY CHAOME

• Full control — edit one detail or redesign everything
• Live previews so you see changes before you export
• Standard .mtz output that the stock Themes app accepts
• No root; Shizuku handles installation on Android 11+
• Clean, fast, modern interface

Note: ChaoMe Theme Editor is an independent tool for creating theme files. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Xiaomi. MIUI and HyperOS are trademarks of Xiaomi Inc., used here only to describe device compatibility.

Design your look. Export it. Wear it. Get ChaoMe Theme Editor.
